studies.title: Black pepper
studies.caption: Black pepper begins as berries on a climbing vine. Harvesting and drying those berries supplied one of the most valuable goods in long-distance spice trade.
studies.prompt: Close study of Piper nigrum climbing a rough tree support, simple pointed heart-ovate leaves and slender hanging spikes of many round green pepper berries. A few dried black peppercorns resting on a fallen leaf nearby. Humid Malabar setting, no chili pods or long pepper catkins.
